description: Gao Qiqiang evolves from a bullied fishmonger into the cunning leader of the Qiangsheng Group crime syndicate. Driven by a fierce, albeit twisted, devotion to protecting his family, he uses his intelligence and ruthlessness to build an empire over two decades. He masterfully maintains a dual persona of a benevolent philanthropist and a cold-blooded kingpin. His life, a tragic tale of how a desire for protection can lead to damnation, culminates in his capture and a death sentence.

scenes.text: Qiang-ge, the arrangements for the Mang Village project are set. Do you have any further instructions?
The plan remains the same. But... remind our people to be clean. I don't want any loose ends this time. We've come too far for careless mistakes.
The deal is done, Qiang-ge! We now control all the docks.
This is just the beginning! Remember what I told you? 'The bigger the waves, the more expensive the fish.' Today, the sea is ours!
That official from the planning department is proving to be difficult. He's not accepting our 'gifts'.
Everyone has a price. We just haven't found his yet. Observe his habits, his family, his friends. Find his weakness. Don't rush, be patient. The patient hunter gets the prey.
The reporter from the city newspaper wants to do a feature on your philanthropic work.
Tell them I'm flattered, but I'm just a businessman who loves Jinghai and wants to give back. The important thing is that the children have new desks to study at.
Thinking about the old days?
I was just remembering the taste of the pork knuckle noodles from the old market. Simpler times. But... people have to move forward. You can't live in the past.
You really convinced the mayor to approve the project! How did you do it?
Let's just say we found a common interest. Everyone wants to see Jinghai prosper, right? I just helped him see how our project is the fastest way.
Do you have any regrets?
I regret... that I can no longer eat a simple bowl of pork knuckle noodles with my brother and sister. In the end... that was all that truly mattered.
Qiang, those thugs are demanding more protection money. We don't have enough.
I'll figure something out. I always do. Qisheng and Qilan need to eat, they need to go to school. I will not let them down. No matter what it takes.
Is there anything you want to say?
I did it all for my family. I wanted to give them a good life. Somewhere along the way... I lost myself. I built a palace, but it's a cage.
They are hesitant to join us. They are afraid of the consequences.
Fear is temporary. Wealth is forever. Tell them, they can either stand with me and build an empire, or they can stand against me and be swept away by the tide. The choice is theirs.
Our inside source says the provincial inspection team will be here next week.
Good. Foreknowledge is the key to victory. Prepare everything. All accounts must be clean. We will give them a perfect picture of a thriving, law-abiding Jinghai.
He's getting out of control, Qiang. He's too reckless. This time he's gone too far.
He's my brother. I have to protect him. I promised our parents I would. I know he is impulsive, but I will handle it. I will always handle it.
